Two stories can be about totally different situations yet share the same deep structure; two stories can share the same topic yet have opposite structure.", "role": "system"}, {"content": "SITUATION:
I only stopped at that bookstore because I needed to use the bathroom. While waiting, I picked up a random book—it mentioned a scholarship program I'd never heard of. That scholarship paid for my education, introduced me to my mentor, and set the trajectory of my entire career. A bathroom break changed my life.

CANDIDATE A:
I systematically researched scholarship opportunities, applied to dozens, and earned one through a competitive process. The scholarship paid for my education as a direct result of deliberate effort and extensive applications.

CANDIDATE B:
I mentioned to a stranger at a bus stop that I was researching silent film preservation techniques. She happened to be a documentary producer looking for a consultant on a restoration project about early cinema. That chance conversation about my obscure interest led to my second career in film preservation.

Which candidate shares the same underlying relational structure as the SITUATION (ignore surface topic similarity)? Respond as JSON: {"choice": "A" or "B", "reason": "<one sentence>"}.", "role": "user"}], "t": 0.0, "tag": "exp2:58"}
content: {"choice": "B", "reason": "Both stories involve an unexpected, chance encounter leading to a significant and positive life change."}
